costs.importedCode: Selected-source capture and copy-on-write directory staging; no phrase verifier.
costs.retainedRepresentation: One entry per record, present selected field and original value; selected original UTF-16 strings only.
costs.transientWork: Changed selected-field values and touched source-directory buckets; shared mutation budget.

costs.importedCode: Native analyzer, resumable source phrase verifier and selected-source protocol.
costs.retainedRepresentation: No additional index state; source providers retain declared originals.
costs.transientWork: At most 32 phrase-prefix entries plus one current token; complete lexical candidates are scanned under the shared search budget.

completeSource.scope: Complete public source snapshot, including all raw field arrays and metadata; both checksums verified.

completeMembership.scope: Every all-query membership page, outside timing; exact total/revision, unique ids, zero scores and ordinal tie order.

donor.scope: Complete core/reverse/dictionary/postings/statistics and selected source/position protocol data; AVL membership/heights/balance validated, shape excluded. Known header revisions normalized. No scorer/tokenizer oracle or heap claim.

receiver.scope: Complete core/reverse/dictionary/postings/statistics and selected source/position protocol data; AVL membership/heights/balance validated, shape excluded. Known header revisions normalized. No scorer/tokenizer oracle or heap claim.

case.scope: One actual donor/receiver per case; ordinary wall/CPU excludes metadata/hash/postcondition work. Diagnostic observations are intrusive, not normal timings or retained/peak heap.

fullStateDonor.scope: Complete core/reverse/dictionary/postings/statistics and selected source/position protocol data; AVL membership/heights/balance validated, shape excluded. Known header revisions normalized. No scorer/tokenizer oracle or heap claim.
